title: Great way to tour Sevilla!
text: Such a fun way to see Sevilla.  The bikes were in great shape, very comfy seats & easy to ride.  E were given a map & instructions on sites to visit, where bike lanes were located and advice on riding through particular areas.  A great experience!
author: Terry_E

title: So easy
text: So easy. Ordered  online and confirmed immediately. Bike pick up and drop off was seamless. Bikes were very comfortable . Highly recommend.
author: clairelB4663NO

title: Bicycle rental Seville
text:
A very nice bike ride to discover Seville 
A very friendly renter with whom everything goes well.
Do not hesitate!
author: marinerT4186NC

title: Very good Service and a...
text: Very good Service and very close and pleasant attention.  A tenner. Bikes are functional. If I go back to Seville I know where to go for the bike.
author: Ruben_M

title: It was great! Easy...
text: It was great! Easy reservation, wide variety of bikes, nice workers. Travelling through Sevilla on bikes was a wonderful experience.
author: Holly_D

title: Great shop. Really good value
text: Great place to rent a bike. The five Hour option was really good value. Their customer service was excellent. I arrived a day early and they willingly ported my booking to the day before without any hassle or cost. Bikes were well maintained and had gears. The best place to ride is along the river. We went in both directions but I would recommend going away from the city.
author: Z7194ZRianw

title: Easy to rent with just a...
text: Easy to rent with just a few clicks, nice staff, and a great working bike. Perfect to get around Sevilla.
author: Eva_L

title: Get on a bike
text: Abby from the city tourism office in Triana recommended this place... and she got it right.  Prices are reasonable and the shop is located in a great place to begin a cycling adventure. Great experience.
author: Elizabeth7020

title: Good place to hire a bike
text: cycled out to italica. bike hire staff are friendly and helpful. Bikes are rugged and heavy but sufficient! Lots of bike routes available. Hire rates are very reasonable!
author: KetteringH

title: Visit new areas of Seville on a bike
text:
Booked online and picked up in-store. 
Quick and easy pick-up. The bikes were is good condition and wouldn't hesitate to recommend this supplier.
